notes: Written from specs/patterns/graph-layout.qnt: the layered pipeline of Eclipse Layout Kernel (cycle breaking, layering, ordering) over four nodes and six pair slots, checked against elk-rs 0.12.2 with the portable strategies pinned (cycle breaking by model order, longest-path layering, no crossing minimization). A scenario picks one of the six modelled graphs with set_graph and runs the pipeline with layout (or the three phases one by one); the expectation is the layers, the layer's node ids sorted, because which node sits above which is the engine's crossing-minimization choice and not part of this contract.

skipped.reason: the order inside a layer is the crossing-minimization strategy's: with no minimization ELK orders by the edge model order (a -> d, a -> b puts d above b), so the scenarios compare layers and the spec's ranking invariant is checked against itself, not against elk
coordinates, spacing, bend points and ports are geometry; the rank is what placement consumes and what the discrete contract can state without a pixel model
compound nodes, cross-hierarchy edges, ports, labels, partitions and layer constraints are intermediate processors and node splitting: the second slice, each with its own model
network simplex, Brandes-Kopf and orthogonal routing pick which valid layout is drawn, not which invariants hold; the spec pins the strategies a port can reproduce exactly
